label: Dashboard Data
description: Production package for a quiet operational dashboard family with deterministic KPI, chart, and operations-table states driven strictly by fixture data.
avoidFor: story-led cinematic hooks without structured data
product-first showcase scenes where media is the subject
freeform collage scenes without explicit metric ownership

renderCost.notes: The family renders four synchronized data panels, state-specific empty/loading/error handling, and chart normalization without external assets.

reducedMotion.notes: Dense scenes reduce travel distance, and the edge fixture renders in static mode while preserving the full information hierarchy.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast typography, restrained semantic colors, and fixed column alignment keep dense operational panels readable.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when the narration depends on real structured metrics, explicit trend context, and operational status reporting.

sourcePolicy.notes: The family uses original Lucida dashboard layout grammar, semantic tokens, and fixture-driven data only. No product screenshot, logo, icon pack, or font binary is registered.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and app-root availability remain untouched because they are outside this ownership slice.
16:9 support is metadata-ready only; this task renders portrait review frames only.
